t: Powerful drain and plug unblocker in a ready-to-use formula. Targets blocked drains in bathroom and utility areas, unclogging drains which have hair, soap scum, toilet paper or other blockages. Works within 30 minutes allowing water to flow freely again, without damaging plastic pipes. Pour in, leave to work, then rinse. For stubborn blockages fill the sink with warm water and 3 cups of the product, leave to stand overnight and rinse with warm water in the morning.
